inserts.description: At a real ordinary Earth vegetable plot shortly before summoning, TWO unequal shots: upper near-full-width closeup of Kou's trowel opening wet soil, lower larger medium view of Kou kneeling beside normal leafy vegetable rows. Same tan work jacket, cream shirt, green waist apron and brown boots. Real outdoor sky allowed ONLY in this memory. No other people, no magic yet.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 日常の手仕事を見せ、塔の畑への伏線にする。

soundEffects.source: hand trowel enters soil
soundEffects.placement: small rough dark-brown letters beside the blade

inserts.description: ONE borderless tall vertical transition. Earth soil and Kou's working hand at the top are interrupted by a brilliant white flash. The light descends through the middle into a pale ivory empty-looking fall, then one closeup of his startled eye at the bottom. He does not die or get injured. No tower, gate, future cause, symbols or magical source revealed. A disorienting moment rather than a poster.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 光と白い間をたどり、着地の場所を次まで見せない。

soundEffects.source: sudden summoning flash
soundEffects.placement: bold white-center gold-outlined letters at the upper flash, upright, no balloon

inserts.description: THREE unequal successive observations inside the tower lane, no combat: upper shallow closeup of an anonymous armored guard's boots and sheathed sword passing; middle small RIGHT closeup of Kou's startled eye; lower larger wide view from behind Kou watching ordinary adventurers move under sandstone ceiling ribs. The guard wears a plain steel helmet, NOT Leon, no silver-haired face. Keep all weapons sheathed. Kou alone from main reference.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 靴、剣、通行人を見て異世界だと理解する。

soundEffects.source: guard armor moves while walking
soundEffects.placement: small hard metallic dark-gray lettering near armor

soundEffects.source: guard boots on stone

inserts.description: THREE unequal shots at same wooden administrative stall. Establish Kou standing RIGHT and older gray-haired, small gray-bearded clerk in plain beige robe LEFT behind desk. Top two-shot Kou asks where he is. Middle close ONLY gentle clerk asks about injury. Bottom larger close ONLY Kou checks dirty but uninjured hand, answers hesitantly. No gate, maps, future answers. Clerk not Balt or Leon, no hat or weapons.
dialogue: すみません。ここは、どこですか？
inserts.scrollPurpose: 場所を尋ねる普通の問いから始め、係員の気遣いで会話を成立させる。

inserts.description: TWO very unequal silent shots after the clerk's answer: upper tall borderless view of a shut pale stone return portal recessed under sandstone ribs, inert and dark, with Kou small at its foot; lower narrow closeup of Kou's empty open hand relaxing into a tense fist. No magical portal opening, no code, no modern phone, no proof of why it is shut.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 帰れない事実を受け止める無音の間。

soundEffects.source: Kou tightens his fist
soundEffects.placement: small beside the clenched hand

inserts.description: THREE unequal successive CLOSEUPS after Kou leaves stall and sees shut gate. Top his hand opens EXISTING rectangular brown LEATHER TOOL SATCHEL at belt, sees worn trowel handle, small notebook and string; not coin purse. Middle boot steps on tower paving. Bottom larger hand on stomach under cream shirt and green apron. Single thought belongs to TOP tool shot. NO wallet, coin purse, money, phone, meal or Elna. Ivory space around asymmetrical hand and boot panels.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 持っているのは作業道具だけだと確かめ、食事代を持たない事情を伝える。

soundEffects.source: Kou boot on paving
soundEffects.placement: small letters by sole

soundEffects.source: Kou stomach

inserts.description: ONE long borderless vertical composition, portrait approximately 1:3, a camera journey rather than a page grid. At the top only a partial open diner window and the cream sleeve of the unseen cook's knife hand chopping on a CLEAN kitchen board; warm steam drifts downward through empty ivory space; at the bottom Kou at the lane looks toward the same blue-awning timber diner. Elna's face is not shown yet. Garden remains wilted. No harvest of new crops.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 包丁の音を先に届け、湯気を追って食堂へ着く。

soundEffects.source: cook knife tapping chopping board inside window
soundEffects.placement: small rhythmic dark-brown lettering at the upper chopping hand

inserts.description: Two unequal recognition shots at same diner window. Kou remains seated outside on RIGHT with the brown water cup; Elna stands inside on LEFT. Upper medium Elna notices his work clothes and tool satchel, asks about farming. Lower larger seated Kou answers. No dirty tool held or placed on food counter, no location change, no diagnosis or work agreement yet.
dialogue: 七年、野菜を作ってました。
inserts.scrollPurpose: 料理人が、農夫へ畑の相談をする理由を作る。

inserts.description: ONE borderless vertical camera journey from the blue diner awning at the upper-left along the narrow stone side path toward wilted garden beds to the right. Elna leads, Kou follows; below, the reader sees wet paving, boots at the edge and sagging leaves. Keep plants rooted, yellow-green and wilted, no healthy regrowth. The paved lane is left and garden right, under tower ceiling, no outdoor sky.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 食堂と畑の位置を、歩く視線と水の跡でつなぐ。

soundEffects.source: Kou boot meets small puddle on path
soundEffects.placement: soft small letters at water contact, away from faces

inserts.description: THREE unequal diagnostic closeups in SAME wilted garden: top shallow closeup of dry crumbly top skin; middle larger Kou's fingers press below it and reveal wet dark soil sticking together; bottom Elna's worried face while holding the CLOSED small fertilizer sack. No watering action, root pulling or instant cure. Kou remains crouched beside Elna.
dialogue: 乾いてるのは、表面だけ。
inserts.scrollPurpose: 表面の乾きと根域の湿りを別々に見る。

soundEffects.source: wet soil compressed gently between fingers
soundEffects.placement: small soft mud-colored letters beside fingers

inserts.description: TWO quiet medium closeups before the root inspection. Kou is crouching with a hand trowel beside one wilted plant still ROOTED, pointing to that single plant; Elna agrees with a hesitant face. No already extracted plant, no removal before permission. Garden architecture and closed fertilizer sack continue.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 触る前に一株の確認を求め、根を見る行動へつなぐ。

inserts.description: TWO unequal panels following the existing root inspection: upper large precise closeup of the SAME one small wilted leafy plant held gently, wet compact dark soil on damaged brown roots; lower shoulder-view of Kou explaining briefly while Elna listens. No magical glow, no healthy bright roots or revived leaves. Only this one plant is uprooted, others remain in beds.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 根の傷みを見て、水の出口を調べる判断へ進む。

soundEffects.source: one muddy water droplet falling off exposed soil
soundEffects.placement: small understated letters next to droplet

inserts.description: TWO uneven emotional shots in the same plot: upper large close face of Elna, headscarf and lower ponytail, holding her small CLOSED fertilizer sack against chest, ashamed but capable; lower off-center close face of Kou with patient expression looking toward path drain, no accusation. Wilted plants stay wilted. No new person.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 世話をしたのに悪化した気持ちを受け止める。

inserts.description: ONE tall borderless approximately 1:3 vertical camera journey, showing wet soil at garden edge near top, a small stagnant trickle reaching downward between stone edging and wet footprints, then a wooden inspection lid partly entering the bottom. No opened lid, no litter yet revealed, no repaired strong flow. People mostly offscreen, only Kou's brown boot and pointed hand guide observation. Plot to right, side path to left.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 水の跡を下へたどり、出口の位置を見つける。

soundEffects.source: drop from saturated soil falling into stagnant edge puddle
soundEffects.placement: small thin gray-blue lettering near upper drop

inserts.description: THREE small quick asymmetric action shots after permission. RIGHT upper shot: Kou pulls the iron ring on the wooden inspection lid with his dirty hand. CENTER lower shot: Elna lifts the SAME rectangular wooden lid by the edge with both hands. LEFT lowest shot: she rests the lid upright safely on paving. The open channel is still blocked with packed wet leaves, no flowing water yet. No digging or breaking sandstone.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 木蓋の重さと手順を小さい動作で読む。

soundEffects.source: wooden lid lifted

soundEffects.source: wooden lid rests on paving

inserts.description: THREE unequal observations of the SAME open inspection channel. Upper precise closeup of a compact mat of leaves and mud wedged at accessible mouth of shallow stone outlet; middle Kou crouches and points without removing it; lower small Elna looks at his pointing hand. Stagnant water is upstream of the mat, downstream still only damp. Elna keeps the lid aside upright. No drained bed or lush plants.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 何が水を止めるか、詰まりの場所を接写で示す。

inserts.description: ONE large wide situation panel within a tall portrait field, with a smaller downward eye-line inset: Kou follows the shallow downstream stone channel toward the OPEN common receiver beside the lane. The downstream path is unobstructed and not overflowing. He checks before clearing the upstream blockage. Elna remains nearby holding/resting the cover aside, not vanished or at another location. No water gush yet, no structural excavations.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 掃除の前に受け入れ先を確かめる。

inserts.description: THREE tight quick diagonally bordered action closeups, all upright lettering: top-right Kou's small hand trowel scrapes packed wet leaf litter; middle-left his hand transfers removed litter into an ordinary dirty garden bucket on paving; lower wide hand closeup loosens the remaining small twig at the outlet. Elna helps hold the lid aside. The last obstruction remains, so water is not yet gushing. No clean food bowl, no fertilizer applied.

soundEffects.source: wet leaves land in dirty utility bucket

inserts.scrollPurpose: 小さな予兆の音から、水が動く結果まで待たせる。

Water leaves the cleared stone outlet, curves downward through the shallow stone channel and joins the common drain. Removed leaves are in a dirty utility bucket at top, wooden cover rests upright outside. Wilted yellow-green plants remain wilted. Large ざああっ follows the current in upper third. No magic.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 流れる水を下へ追う長い見せ場。

soundEffects.source: released water through the cleared stone channel
soundEffects.placement: large flowing blue-gray drawn letters parallel to current in upper third, no balloon

inserts.description: TWO unequal quiet emotion panels at the same now-flowing drain. Upper larger Elna sees moving water, eyes widen and shoulders ease, but she does not celebrate restored plants. Lower Kou looks to the still-wilted bed with cautious hope, the cleared drain and resting lid still nearby. No supporting heroes, no recovered crop, no harvest.
inserts.scrollPurpose: 水が動いた喜びと、作物を待つ時間を分ける。

inserts.scrollPurpose: 作業の片付けと手洗いを、食堂へ入る前に描く。

Top small closeup of Kou blowing gently on a spoonful from the SAME mottled ceramic stew bowl, matching barley, brown meat, orange root and greens. Middle LARGE closeup of his softened face after tasting, his rough hands now clean, warmth rather than victory smugness. Bottom wider quiet counter scene, Elna asks from LEFT and Kou answers slightly lower RIGHT; leave airy ivory space between reactions. No crop recovery, new morning or future customer. Garden seen through doorway is still wilted.

adoptionAdjustments: 畑の移動は後の会話が混ざった原画を編集し、一枚の縦長場面へ変更。
水の予兆は人物と閉じた木蓋を除き、小さい泡だけへ編集。
水路の移動は繰り返し人物コマを除き、一本の流れへ編集。
蓋の状態をつなぐため片付け・手洗いを安堵の会話の前へ移動。
閉門後の握る音グッを記録。泥を除く音は原画で読めるべちゃのみ採用。
予兆の画内の静かな間を含めて測り、追加の空白を950pxから400pxへ短縮。
会話場面は原画の文字を優先して全幅へ広げ、無言の手元・動作場面で左右の幅を変える。
